name: codex0_166_0_apply_patch_new_file_allowed
description: Codex CLI 0.166.0 apply_patch call for a new file in the working tree. The call has no path parameter: the patch text in command names the file. The hook reads the file from the line '*** Add File:' and places it under cwd, and no rule denies that path. The patch text is the one the release run recorded for the stage write_tool_allow_control.

capture.sanitisation: tool name, parameter name and patch text are from the reduced hook record of the harness run of 2026-11-10; the envelope fields are those of codex_bash_shell, because a harness run does not keep them

*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: allowed-by-tool.txt
+written-by-write-tool
